You can find it here on the Timeline... I will pin it here for you on this video. After this video is recorded you'll find it... for the next one or two days on our X-Channel... probably only for the next few hours to be honest. But this is our 2026 Outlook video update. I recorded the first one I think three months ago. So this is me going back to what I said back then. Updating the higher timeframe chart giving you all the context you need to know. And a more specific forecast for Q2. I think this is probably the most important ADA video for the coming weeks or even months. This gives you the bigger picture. So I'm gonna pin it after this recording is finished so you'll find it on X. I'll put the link into the the comments section, by the way... In the comment section, by the way, you'll find a lot of additional updates there as well on X in case you're not following there yet so much more than you can find here so looking at the short-term chart for ada this remains an ongoing sideways range um i like to distinguish between a main support area here you know where we've got support levels at 22.7 cents, 23.3 cents, 24.3 cents and 25 cents. Yeah, as main support. And then micro support which is not so relevant, but you just have some levels to watch. Right? And so we want to talk a little bit about these two zones here and why they are relevant. Look, the overall idea is that we have seen from the high on the 17th or 18th of March... March, we've seen a 5-wave decline. I haven't specifically labeled it because I try to keep the chart as clean as possible. But it's seen as a directional move. So this looks more directional, more impulsive than any of the previous declines. Look, all of this was corrective in nature. Three waves, three waves. This here looks potentially a 5 wave move. That being said, you might be able to interpret it as 3 waves, but it doesn't make a great difference because Bitcoin is probably the leading factor here, Ethereum as well. And they have formed five waves down that are even clearer. And so what we did expect this week is a bounce into resistance. That resistance area was reached yesterday. It's between 26.5 and 28.4 cents. And if you watched yesterday's video, then you know this resistance area already. This is unchanged. Market simply moved into it it and this is where we are now and then we already have a rejection from resistance. Is this really a surprise? Not so much because a rejection from resistance is actually expected. Now the main question to me is at the moment, have we already topped in this B wave and we're going down in the C wave because that's's the roadmap we're tracking here? So this is again micro support, it could easily break. Easily, yeah. It's also not a surprise that we found support here again because this is again the main support a 25 cents, and it's where we have support before you know in March early in March so but again we have to deal with this now ABC that's the roadmap the main question is is this B wave already in and we topped or do we form a wider ABC structure to the upside because a B wave is a three wave move but a three wave move can always turn into a larger ABC pattern a a three wave move. But a three wave move can always turn into a larger ABC pattern, a larger three wave move. And because we really only touch support here, the 38.2 retracement level a couple of times and we don't really have an impulsive decline yet, I would slightly prefer a wider B wave. Again, that's not bullish. I'm just pointing out the possibility we might move a little higher into the resistance area and it's $0.27 27.6 and 28.4 cents as next resistance. So I view this as on a B, C structure in a pullback. We could go a little lower, maybe. The price has already reached here the first microsupport level at 25.9 cents so something to keep um to keep an eye on but yeah overall idea is we're in a pullback we could go a little lower but then this is a zone to watch for a bounce in wave c of b maybe over the coming sessions but really the pressure is down overall until the market actually can break impulsively above our resistance zone at 28.4 cents i'll keep you updated. Hope you like the update. If you did, please hit the like button, leave a comment, and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates, then I recommend that you check out, yeah, on our X channel. Make sure you follow there now. I put the link into the comments. Thanks so much. Bye-bye.
